fact_text: PMEX interday contracts are opened and automatically closed within the same trading day, and they differ from normal contracts mainly in their lower initial margin.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'MetaTrader 5 Tutorial: PMEX, Commodity Market & Pakistan Mercantile Exchange Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-01-01)

fact_text: PMEX futures shown in MetaTrader 5 fall into five groups: metals (gold, silver, platinum, aluminium), energy (crude, natural gas, Brent), indices (Dow, DAX, S&P 500, a Japanese equity index), currency pairs and agriculture (cotton, soybean).
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'MetaTrader 5 Tutorial: PMEX, Commodity Market & Pakistan Mercantile Exchange Analysis' (YouTube, 2025-01-01)
